stem.text: Four cars, **A**, **B**, **C** and **D**, move from rest in a straight line. The cars take the same time to accelerate to a velocity of $60\,\text{km h}^{-1}$. Their velocity–time graphs are shown.

stem.alt: Velocity–time graph with the axes labelled velocity /km h-1 (60 marked on the velocity axis) and time, with four curves labelled A, B, C and D.

stem.text: Which car reaches a velocity of $60\,\text{km h}^{-1}$ in the shortest distance?
